protocol_reference.status: internal project protocol v1; main-agent/sponsor confirmation not evidenced in this batch
protocol_reference.use: screening only; no formal trend label assigned

event_identity_rule: One Lokken lawsuit controversy; news links, Reddit posts, HN posts, comments and court records are evidence for the same event, not additional events.

events.window_status: D0=2023-11-15 excluded; seven full UTC dates on each side, for diagnostic comparison only

sources.query_scope: Same exact query, separate story and comment searches; created_at_i bounded to each full UTC window.

baseline.story_title: UnitedHealth made employees use an AI algorithm to end Medicare patients rehab

observation.story_title: UnitedHealth sued over use of algorithm in Medicare Advantage plans
observation.comment_parent_title: UnitedHealth uses AI model with 90% error rate to deny care, lawsuit alleges

sources.assessment: The matching story and one comment are event-relevant, but only 1/7 baseline story days and 1/7 observation story days contain a result. This is a sparse public-discussion series, not broad audience coverage.

sources.source: PullPush archived Reddit search API; endpoint documentation at https://pullpush.io/
sources.query_scope: Same exact query, separate submission and comment searches; after/before timestamps bound to each full UTC window; requested size=1000.

baseline.submission_relevance: Four query-matching titles passed a keyword screen; source titles were not retained in this redacted aggregate, so independent item-level coding remains pending.

observation.submission_relevance: Only 2 of 5 returned titles passed the event-keyword screen; the other 3 are not counted as confirmed event-specific discussion.
observation.comment_relevance: Nine returned comments were not retained or item-level event-coded; do not treat all nine as confirmed event discussion.

sources.assessment: Search/archive proxy only; completeness and query recall are unknown. Returned rows are under the requested cap, but this does not establish platform coverage. No author names, raw post/comment text or item identifiers are retained.

other_later_context.source: Ars Technica contemporaneous article carrying allegations from the lawsuit
other_later_context.use: confirms post-cutoff coverage; no independent count added

other_later_context.source: STAT report on the later case proceeding
other_later_context.use: later context outside the seven-day observation window; excluded from direction label

events.direction_label_basis: Insufficient source coverage and event-coded volume; HN has one story in each window and one observation comment, while Reddit event-specific item coding is incomplete and the active days are sparse. No ratio smoothing or absence inference applied.
events.human_trend_label_status: not_ready; evidence insufficiency means no direction task was issued
events.e_prediction_status: pending; cutoff-only input handed off separately

limitations: Window and numerical gates are internal v1 methods, not sponsor-confirmed requirements.
A search result or a zero result is not a full-platform census; archive completeness and query recall are not established.
The source responses were hashed but raw social content, author identifiers and item IDs were not retained.
Later procedural developments and later public material were not used in the cutoff input or the seven-day trend label.
